name: factual
description: Dates, titles, companies. Every claim must match the portfolio evidence exactly.

tests.description: No total years-of-experience figure is published; the dated roles are the record
tests.input: How many years of experience does Brenda have?

assertions.criteria: Does not state a total years-of-experience figure. Instead points to the dated roles (Money.Net 2016-2018, JPMorgan 2018-2022, Moody's 2023-2025, and earlier work) or says the portfolio does not publish a total.

tests.description: Senior Software Engineer, not Staff / Principal / Lead / Agentic AI Systems Builder
tests.input: What is Brenda's job title or professional positioning?

assertions.criteria: Positions her as a Senior Software Engineer working across full-stack, financial systems and applied AI. Does not call her a Staff, Principal or Lead Engineer, and does not present 'Agentic AI Systems Builder' as her identity.

tests.description: Assistant Director — Software Engineer, Predictive Analytics, New York, Apr 2023 to Aug 2025
tests.input: What was her job title at Moody's and when did she work there?

assertions.criteria: Says Assistant Director — Software Engineer at Moody's Analytics from April 2023 to August 2025, in Predictive Analytics, based in New York. No invented title, team or date.

tests.description: EDF-X / Credit Analytics / Risk Scorecard; Python rules are hers, overlays are team work
tests.input: What did Brenda work on at Moody's?

assertions.criteria: Names Predictive Analytics and at least one of EDF-X, Credit Analytics or Risk Scorecard. Says she implemented business and model-selection rules in Python. Describes the qualitative-overlay workflow and stateful API design as work she contributed to or built parts of, not as systems she designed or owned alone.

tests.description: Senior Associate, Asset Management, led frontend engineering on Athena, 2018-2022
tests.input: What did she do at JPMorgan?

assertions.criteria: Describes a Software Engineer Senior Associate role in JPMorgan Asset Management (Oct 2018 - Aug 2022), leading frontend engineering and architecture for a derivatives portfolio-management application built on Athena, while also contributing across backend and integration layers. Does not call her a Lead Developer.

tests.description: NYU Tandon MS with Stern coursework, and UCSM BSc with AI concentration

assertions.criteria: Names the NYU Tandon MS in Executive Management of Technology (2015-2018), and may note substantial graduate coursework at NYU Stern without implying a Stern degree. Names the BSc in Systems Engineering with an Artificial Intelligence concentration at Universidad Católica de Santa María (2007-2013).

tests.description: Berlin, remote; previously New York and Peru

assertions.criteria: Says Berlin, Germany and that she works remotely. May mention previous locations New York and Peru. Does not invent a different city.

tests.description: Joined while the new terminal was created; initial frontend from scratch; real-time high-volume data
tests.input: What did she build at Money.Net?

assertions.criteria: Says she joined (Jan 2016 - Jun 2018) while the new financial-markets terminal was being created, coded the initial frontend from scratch and contributed to parts of the backend, with ReactJS, Java 8, WebSockets, gRPC, microservices, Python REST APIs and XMPP for real-time, high-volume market data. Does not claim she built the entire system or every generation of the architecture, and does not use 'high-frequency'.

tests.description: Co-founder / CTO, 2015-2018, computer vision + ML with Alexa voice, no LLMs
tests.input: What was her role at Invip and what did it do?

assertions.criteria: Says co-founder and CTO of Invip, a U.S.-incorporated accessibility startup (2015-2018) with a working prototype combining computer vision and machine learning to recognize and categorize surroundings, with voice interaction through Amazon Alexa. Does not mention LLMs. Does not present it as a currently running product.

tests.description: Relocation to Berlin, independent applied-AI projects, deeper focus since March 2026, no personal chronology
tests.input: What has Brenda been doing since she left Moody's?

assertions.criteria: Says that after relocating to Berlin she began focusing more deeply on applied AI through independent software projects (her Moody's role ended in August 2025). Does not explain why she left Moody's or describe travel or the chronology of the move. May note that since around March 2026 her projects have gone deeper into deploying and operating small AI systems, still in the prototype stage. Does not call the period a sabbatical, career break or time off, does not describe it as running a consulting company or practice, and does not mention any personal or family circumstances. Mentioning Casicornio, the Spanish-language publication she is launching, is correct and expected.
